title: GovernanceEvent
description: Types the data payload flowing through Governance Effectors/Receptors when the payload is a governance event message. A governance event signals a state change in the governance lifecycle — an evaluation trigger, a compliance assertion, or a sourcing notification. Extending archetypes add domain-specific payloads via $ref/allOf composition. Source: ITIP Meta-Governance Framework; GSM Directive/Norm/Ascription governance grammar.

eventType.description: Governance event discriminator. EVALUATION_TRIGGER — signals that an evaluation cycle should be initiated for the referenced subject. COMPLIANCE_ASSERTION — asserts a compliance posture change for a governed entity. SOURCING_NOTIFICATION — notifies that a framework sourcing operation completed (new directives/norms ingested). Source: ITIP meta-governance; GSM Ascription lifecycle.

subjectRef.description: URI reference to the governance subject — the Definition or Ascription instance that this event pertains to (e.g., 'gsmarc://tenant/definitions/{id}'). Source: GSM Ascription lifecycle; ITIP evaluation model.

frameworkRef.description: URI reference to the governance framework under which this event is raised (e.g., 'gsmarc://frameworks/gdpr/v1'). Optional for cross-framework events. Source: ITIP framework catalog.

payload.description: Event-specific content. At protocol level, unconstrained; extending archetypes constrain this to a domain-specific shape via $ref/allOf composition.
